extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
Dare to enter Duskmourn, a plane-enveloping House that sets the scene for your opponent’s greatest fears to come to life!
Play Boosters are perfect for Limited play and fun to open, with a possibility of Art cards, alternate art, special frames, and additional Rares and/or Mythic Rares. Draft with friends, frighten up your deck, or find some Booster Fun! Look for 10 new Special Guest cards!

Contents:
• Each Duskmourn: House of Horror - Play Booster Box includes 36 booster packs, each contains 14 cards and 1 Token/Ad card or Art Series card
• Each Play Booster contains 1–4 cards of rarity Rare or higher, including the possibility of a Borderless Mythic Rare card from Magic’s history
• very booster also includes at least 1 shining Traditional Foil card of any rarity; in 20% of packs you’ll also find a Traditional Foil Land card
